name: Fieldwerk
description:
Your best thinking often happens right in the AI chat thread — a sharp answer, a plan taking shape, a draft that's nearly there. But that work is easily lost in long threads, and it's tricky to untangle a complex idea or bring other people in. Copy-pasting out to another system is laborious, and it disconnects the work from your AI.

Fieldwerk fixes that. Just ask Claude to create a memo — a markdown file with its own URL — and your thinking is out of the thread but still live and connected. Pull a dense response apart, rework it, and shape it into what you need — your AI working right alongside you on the memo. Pick the work up a minute or six months later and your AI picks it up with you. Share it as a viewer, commenter, or editor, and your team — and their AI — get the same live access you have.

Fieldwerk is the workbench for thinking in progress and work in flight, and integrates seamlessly with the tools you already use, so there's nothing to migrate. It works from Claude, Claude Code, or any MCP-enabled tool. It's built for anyone who works with AI — on your own or across a team — and can be connected in under a minute. Head to fieldwerk.ai for a free account and to find out more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fieldwerk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fieldwerk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.fieldwerk.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fieldwerk MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fieldwerk lists 96 MCP tools, including ack_inbox, add_asset_from_url, add_link_asset, add_list_item, add_memo_to_collection, add_memo_to_notebook, add_reaction, add_table_row, append_to_memo, append_to_section, archive_collection, and archive_notebook.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fieldwerk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fieldwerk in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Fieldwerk requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fieldwerk is developed by Fieldwerk. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
